text: A dense neural-network layer connects each input to each output neuron. If there are I input features and J output neurons, its weight matrix has J rows. A bias can be represented by an additional constant input equal to one. Including this constant gives I plus one columns and J times I plus one weights. A feedforward network passes information from its input through hidden layers toward the output.
